# Animal Crossing: Wild World Archipelago v0.1.0-alpha

Welcome to the public alpha release of Animal Crossing: Wild World for Archipelago!

This release contains the initial playable implementation of Animal Crossing: Wild World featuring museum-based progression, seasonal month progression, a custom BizHawk Master Controller, and PopTracker support.

---

## Downloads

### acww.apworld **(REQUIRED)**

The Archipelago world file.

Install by placing it into your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder.

---

### connector_bizhawk_acww.lua **(REQUIRED)**

The Lua connector used by BizHawk to communicate with the Archipelago server.

Install by placing it into your Archipelago/data/lua folder.

---

### acww_poptracker.zip **(OPTIONAL)**

Optional PopTracker package for automatic tracking.

---

## Supported Versions

- Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer
- BizHawk 2.11.1
- Animal Crossing: Wild World (USA) (Rev 1)
- Game Code: ADME

Additional ROM revisions are planned for future releases.

---

## Features

- Catchsanity
- Museumsanity
- Journal Milestones
- Museum Percentage Milestones
- Configurable Museum Goal
- Month Progression
- High-RNG Catch Progression Exclusion
- Master Controller
- Restore AP Progress
- Recover Undonated Specimens
- Reclaim Renewable Resources
- Weed Removal
- PopTracker Support

---

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/MikeFritzDevelops/ACWW-Archipelago#readme)
- [Setup Guide](https://github.com/MikeFritzDevelops/ACWW-Archipelago/blob/main/acww/docs/setup_en.md)
- [Game Guide](https://github.com/MikeFritzDevelops/ACWW-Archipelago/blob/main/acww/docs/game_en.md)
- [Master Controller Guide](https://github.com/MikeFritzDevelops/ACWW-Archipelago/blob/main/acww/docs/controller.md)

---

## Alpha Notice

This is an early alpha release.

Bug reports, balance feedback, and suggestions are greatly appreciated.

v0.1.1-alpha.description:
## v0.1.1-alpha

### Added

- Refactored memory profile architecture to lay the groundwork for future game version support.
- Improved the inventory watcher to use stable inventory snapshots before processing changes.

### Changed

- **Starter Kit** renamed to **Start with Tools**
- **Start with Tools** now grants the tools without sending three initial checks.
- Normal tools no longer considered progression for logic; Golden tools remain randomized items.
- Updated PopTracker with monthly Bug and Fish Journals, improved availability information, and corrected bug and fish logic.

### Fixed

- Museum goal validation now raises an 'OptionError' instead of 'ValueError'.
- Fixed several client-side issues related to starting tool handling and internal state synchronization.
- General stability improvements and code cleanup.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/MikeFritzDevelops/ACWW-Archipelago#readme)
